newsitem.title: INDIA: CARE says pace of investment in India slowing down.
newsitem.headline: CARE says pace of investment in India slowing down.

text.p: Pace of investment in India is showing signs of a slowdown, the Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Friday.

"With the recent slowdown in the growth rate in some industrial sectors and the prevailing high rates of interest, the pace of investment and the demand for funds from financial institutions are showing signs of a slowdown," it said in a report on Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India (ICICI).
CARE assigned a AAA (triple A) rating for ICICI's proposed unsecured bond issue of 7.5 billion rupees, with a green shoe option of 7.5 billion.
"Instruments carrying this rating are considered to be of the best quality, carrying negligible investment risk," it said.
ICICI is one of India's leading long-term lending banks.
